hero.title: About NovaLikes
hero.description:
NovaLikes is a premium social media growth platform built to help creators, businesses, and brands grow with high-quality social signals.

We focus on a clear ordering experience, secure checkout, and reliable delivery across Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, and more.

mission.title: Helping You Grow. The Right Way.
mission.description:
Our mission is to help you boost your social media presence safely and effectively — with clear packages, password-free ordering, and support when you need it.

We believe growth should feel simple: choose a service, pick a package, provide a public URL, and track your order with confidence.

items.title: Safe & Secure
items.description: Encrypted checkout and password-free ordering keep your accounts protected.

items.title: Clear Package Pricing
items.description: Compare quantities and prices before checkout so you know which package you are choosing.

items.title: Platform-Specific Services
items.description: Packages are listed by Instagram, TikTok, and Facebook metric rather than as a generic growth mix.

items.title: Customer Support
items.description: Contact NovaLikes with package, order, or payment questions using the available support options.

items.title: 30-Day Money-Back Guarantee
items.description: Eligible purchases are covered by our 30-Day Money-Back Guarantee under the published Refund Policy.

trust.title: Built on Trust Delivered with Care
trust.description: We are committed to a customer experience that feels clear, secure, and dependable — from package selection to order tracking.
